test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_partial (id UInt64, k UInt8, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
CREATE TABLE t_bypass (id UInt64, k UInt8, s String, INDEX idx s TYPE text(tokenizer = array)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE t_full (id UInt64, k UInt8, s String, INDEX idx s TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_partial SELECT number, if(intDiv(number, 8192) % 100 = 0, 7, 1), concat('tok', toString(number % 1000), ' word', toString(number % 777), ' ', repeat('x', 80)) FROM numbers(5000000)
ALTER TABLE t_partial ADD INDEX idx s TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha)

INSERT INTO t_partial SELECT number + 5000000, if(intDiv(number, 8192) % 100 = 0, 7, 1), concat('tok', toString(number % 1000), ' word', toString(number % 777), ' ', repeat('x', 80)) FROM numbers(5000000)
INSERT INTO t_bypass SELECT number, if(intDiv(number, 8192) % 100 = 0, 7, 1), concat('ab', toString(number % 1000), repeat('y', 90)) FROM numbers(10000000)
